summary: Same converged review, security lens - the dominant lens. No shell string is composed, so pipes/redirects/chaining/globs/substitution are structurally impossible; authorization is the deterministic granted-capability check (no non-deterministic classifier, no autonomous-terminal). Argv is validated against the reviewed pattern with the existing matcher; the executable is verified in place after proving it is outside the agent-writable workspace and not group/other-writable, then run as those same bytes (TOCTOU-safe for the agent). An entry-anchored deadline + pre-spawn abort give at-most-once execution for mutating capabilities. The RunCommand projection is retired so no shell fallback remains.
residual_risks: Deep executable-identity hardening (parent-dir chain immutability, symlink argv0) deferred as D-0056 - outside the agent threat model; requires a co-resident local attacker with write access to a system directory.
